theorems.name: Submission.codim1_zsl_blowUp_centres_near
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N E : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → E ⊆ N → IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN → x ∈ U → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T (xs i) (lams i) (hlams i).ne') S → S.support.Nonempty → x ∈ N ∧ ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < C₀ ∧ ∀ i, ∃ p ∈ N, dist p (xs i) ≤ C₀ * lams i
